wonderful post-holiday, isn't it!
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how was that? A perfect landing, 
wouldn't you say!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying skydiving during my vacation left 
me thoroughly refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Cutting through the wind and soaring 
through the air really does feel 
wonderful! Jumping like this is just

text_block_list.text:
It seems Seeking the Pearl thoroughly 
enjoyed her day off and feels completely 
refreshed.
